links.outcome: Expert-rated satisfaction of ChatGPT answers to hip arthroplasty FAQs by language (English vs Urdu)
links.effect: English: 9/10 satisfactory with minimal clarification, 1/10 moderate. Urdu (Roman and Nastaliq): 1/10 satisfactory with moderate clarification, 9/10 unsatisfactory requiring substantial clarification.
links.quote: In both Roman and Nastaliq script Urdu, 1 (10%) answer was satisfactory requiring moderate clarification, while 9 (90%) were unsatisfactory requiring substantial clarification.

screen.reason: Empirically evaluates ChatGPT's language accuracy and quality (English vs. Urdu) for patient FAQs regarding total hip arthroplasty, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or operational practice.
